debug_all_fields.title: Cold Pressed Neem Oil
debug_all_fields.description:
Having a botanical name of Azadirachta indica, Neem Oil has its origin from India and has a light yellow transparent color with a characteristic neem fragrant odor. With insolubility in water and solubility in alcohol and oils, it has specific gravity of 0.893 at72F and refractive index of 1.479 at72F. With main constituents of salannin, meliantriol, azadirachtin, nimbin, meliantriol, nimbidin, deacetylazadirachtinol, salannin, the oil is extracted using cold pressed process from Neem Tree which is an evergreen tree of moderate height.

The extract is well known as an effective pest inhibitor and a form of tonic as it has antiseptic properties. With common names of Neem, Nimba, it blends well with cedarwood, geranium, florals, sandalwood and is also used in skin diseases like eczema, ulcers and in treating rheumatism.

Specifications :
Botanical NameAzadirachta indica
Common Method of ExtractionPressing and solvent extraction
Parts UsedSeeds
Note ClassificationBase
AromaHerbaceous, Bitter and Extremely Tenacious

 

Chemical Composition :
The neem oil contains Azadirachtin, which can vary from 300ppm to over 2,500ppm depending on the extraction and quality of the Neem seeds. It also contains various limonoids, which includes azadirachtin, azadiradione, fraxinellone, nimbin, salannin, salannol, vepinin and vilasinin. The other active components of neem oil are nimbin, nimbidin and nimbinene plus bitter principles, tannins, flavonoids and sesquiterpene derivatives.

debug_all_fields.title: Green Natural Organic Fungicides
debug_all_fields.description:
Organic fungicides are essential tools in organic farming and gardening to manage fungal diseases while adhering to organic and eco-friendly principles. These products are made from natural ingredients and are approved for use in organic agriculture. They provide effective control against a variety of fungal pathogens without the use of synthetic chemicals. Organic fungicides often contain ingredients like copper, sulfur, neem oil, and plant extracts, which have fungicidal properties and are considered safe for the environment and human health.
 
They are commonly used in organic farming for crops such as fruits, vegetables, and herbs, where fungal diseases like powdery mildew, downy mildew, and various leaf spots are prevalent. Organic fungicides work by disrupting the growth and development of fungal pathogens or by creating a protective barrier on plant surfaces. These products help organic growers maintain the health and quality of their crops, reduce the impact of fungal diseases, and promote sustainable and environmentally friendly agricultural practices. Proper application and adherence to organic farming standards are crucial when using organic fungicides.

Organic fungicides can be used in a wide range of crops in organic farming and gardening. Some of the common crops where organic fungicides are applied include:
 
1. **Fruits:** Organic fungicides are used in fruit crops like apples, grapes, strawberries, and citrus fruits to manage diseases such as apple scab, grape downy mildew, and various fruit rots.
 
2. **Vegetables:** Organic fungicides are applied to vegetables like tomatoes, cucumbers, and peppers to control diseases such as powdery mildew, early blight, and late blight.
 
3. **Herbs:** Herbs like basil, mint, and oregano can benefit from organic fungicides to prevent fungal infections that may affect their quality.
 
4. **Ornamental Plants:** Organic fungicides are also used in gardens and nurseries to protect ornamental plants and flowers from fungal diseases, enhancing their aesthetic value.
 
5. **Field Crops:** In organic farming, field crops like organic grains, legumes, and oilseeds can also benefit from organic fungicides to manage diseases such as rust, smut, and blights.

debug_all_fields.title: Magicmaids Copper Sulphate
debug_all_fields.description: Uses: Copper sulfate is used as a fungicide, algaecide, root killer, and herbicide in both agriculture and non-agricultural settings. It is also used as an antimicrobial and molluscicide. Uses for individual products containing copper sulfate vary widely.

debug_all_fields.title: Copper Sulphate
debug_all_fields.description: Copper sulfate, also known as copper sulphate, are the inorganic compounds with the chemical formula CuSO4(H2O)x, where x can range from 0 to 5. Older names for this compound include blue vitriol, bluestone, vitriol of copper,Neela thota and Roman vitriol.
